prompts.van: Use case: stylized-concept. Production SOURCE sprite sheet for Hollowlight, reference image is the approved machinery sprite and second image approved ruin material style. Generate three isolated views of exactly the SAME abandoned compact service van in three side-by-side columns, equal canvas regions and identical camera, scale, footprint, wheelbase, orientation and alignment. Orthogonal top-down three-quarter game view, van nose points toward TOP, rear at BOTTOM; whole van in each cell, generous transparent margins, no perspective ground plane. LEFT: damaged but complete faded teal-gray maintenance van, rust, dented cream roof, worn tires, dark windows, moss at seams. MIDDLE: the same van with hood panel and engine accessories removed, exposed engine cavity, clearly partly dismantled, body/tires remain. RIGHT: same footprint now a stripped rusted chassis and lower body frame, roof and panels removed, recognizable skeletal van. No driveable or repaired state. Match reference's organic deliberate pixel clusters, material-specific wear, muted gray-green/rust/amber palette, slightly visible front faces; real game sprite artwork, not clean vector geometry. No text, no people, no landscape, no baked environmental lighting or cast shadow pools. True transparent background. Keep vehicle aligned consistently for three animation/state frames. Intended runtime frames128x192 native pixels, 2 native pixels/world unit; preserve recognizable clustered details at reduction.
